newsitem.title: USA: KEDO seeks to buy 70,000 tonnes fuel oil for July.
newsitem.headline: KEDO seeks to buy 70,000 tonnes fuel oil for July.

text.p: The Korean Peninsula Energy Development Organization Tuesday tendered to buy about 70,000 metric tonnes of fuel oil for July delivery to North Korea.
Bids to supply the no. 6 fuel oil with maximum 2 percent sulfur content are due June 18 at 1000 EDT (1400 GMT).

KEDO plans to buy about 22,000 tonnes for delivery to Nampo/Songrim, loading between July 10 and July 24, and plans to buy two cargoes of 23-24,000 tonnes each for Sonbong, loading about 10 days apart between July 10 and July 29.
KEDO, an international organization set up to help freeze North Korea's nuclear weapons program, has agreed to supply the country with 500,000 tonnes of fuel oil a year.
